      labels:
        app: checkoutservice

        fsGroup: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
      containers:
        - name: server
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            capabilities:
              drop:
                - ALL
            privileged: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: false
          image: wangyl2128/checkoutservice-v2:latest
          ports:
          - containerPort: 5050
          readinessProbe:
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            grpc:
              port: 5050
